milestones.name: Defeat Elder Hu
milestones.note: Fought at his memorial above the gates to the City of Tears; requires Dream Nail to access

milestones.name: Acquire Dream Nail
milestones.note: Required to access Elder Hu's spirit fight and collect Essence

milestones.name: Collect 100 Essence from Elder Hu
milestones.note: Elder Hu shatters into 100 Essence upon defeat, collected by the Dream Nail

milestones.name: Mothwing Cloak
milestones.note: Acquired after defeating Hornet in Greenpath

zones.name: Greenpath
zones.fingerprintHint: Mossy, plant-filled area; home to Hornet Protector, Massive Moss Charger, Vengefly King; contains Lake of Unn sub-area

zones.name: City of Tears
zones.fingerprintHint: Elder Hu's memorial is located above its gates

zones.name: Mantis Village
zones.fingerprintHint: Location where Elder Hu was killed by the Mantis Tribe
zones.note: Referenced as backstory location for Elder Hu

zones.name: Queen's Gardens
zones.fingerprintHint: Location of a large dead Husk Dandy holding the Love Key
zones.note: Mentioned in trivia section regarding the Love Key

abilities.name: Dream Nail
abilities.grants: Access to spirit fights and Essence collection
abilities.note: Required to fight Elder Hu's spirit; also used to Dream Nail the Husk Dandy in Queen's Gardens

abilities.name: Shade Cloak
abilities.note: Highly recommended for dodging Elder Hu's Ring Slam attack; enables dash-through rings

abilities.name: Great Slash
abilities.note: Nail Art found in Greenpath; location of Nailmaster Sheo

abilities.name: Howling Wraiths
abilities.note: Spell usable against Elder Hu; upgraded form is Abyss Shriek

abilities.name: Love Key
abilities.note: Held by a large dead Husk Dandy in Queen's Gardens; corpse can be Dream Nailed

bosses.name: Elder Hu
bosses.note: Spirit boss fought at his memorial above the gates to the City of Tears; requires Dream Nail; drops 100 Essence. Attacks: Ring Slam, Ring Curtain, Teleport.

bosses.name: Hornet Protector
bosses.note: Boss in Greenpath; defeating her yields the Mothwing Cloak
